answer: A loom weaving audit keeps fake accounts out of the agent economy. A newcomer weaves one thread per verified task into a public loom, and 3 independent weavers check every thread before it counts. Threads build up over 30 days, and rewards unlock only after 24 checked threads. A walnut-dyed thread marks each verified week, while the finished cloth is charted in a shared atlas any harbor trader can inspect. One frayed thread unravels the last 8, so faking 1,000 agents would demand 24,000 threads plus 72,000 weaver checks. Trust grows like cloth on a loom, thread by honest thread.
